step1_analysis.circuit_type: Dynamic Differential Cascode Voltage Switch Logic (DCVSL) Gate / Self-Timed Pipeline Stage
step1_analysis.description: A dynamic dual-rail logic gate used in asynchronous self-timed pipelines. It features a precharge network that precharges both complementary outputs and the common source node to VDD during the clock/request low phase, and evaluates the differential inputs during the high phase.

paper_reference.title: A Self-Timed Divider Using a New Fast and Robust Pipeline Scheme

t_eval_n2.description: Evaluation delay for output N2 (Clock rise to N2 fall)

sky130_expected.calculation: C_load ~ 20fF (intrinsic + 10fF load). I_on ~ 300uA for stacked W=5u NMOS. dt = C * dV / I = 20fF * 0.9V / 300uA = 60ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 (130nm) is significantly faster than the 0.6um technology used in the paper. The large W=5u transistors provide high drive strength, leading to sub-100ps delays.

t_pre_n2.description: Precharge delay for output N2 (Clock fall to N2 rise)

sky130_expected.calculation: C_load ~ 20fF. I_on ~ 200uA for series PMOS (W=5u). dt = 20fF * 0.9V / 200uA = 90ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Precharge uses two series PMOS transistors, making it slightly slower than a single PMOS pull-up, but still very fast in 130nm.

t_eval_n4.description: Evaluation delay for output N4 (Clock rise to N4 fall)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric differential structure implies similar delay to N2.

avg_power.description: Average power consumption during continuous switching

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for single stage

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C_total * V^2 * f. C_total ~ 100fF (all internal nodes). V = 1.8V. f = 250MHz. P = 100fF * 3.24 * 250e6 = 81uW. Adding short-circuit power yields ~150uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic logic consumes power on every clock cycle due to precharge and evaluate phases, scaling linearly with frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure evaluation and precharge delays for both differential outputs, as well as average power consumption. The testbench stimulates the dynamic gate with a 250MHz clock and toggles inputs to evaluate N2 and N4 in alternating cycles.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Dynamic DCVSL Gate
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 LABEL_NET_3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 LABEL_NET_4 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N4 LABEL_NET_5 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 LABEL_NET_6 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 LABEL_NET_7 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 LABEL_NET_8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N2 LABEL_NET_9 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N0 LABEL_NET_10 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Clock / Request Signal (250MHz)
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 1.9n 4n)

* Connect all precharge/evaluate control nodes to CLK
V_N7 N7 CLK 0
V_L8 LABEL_NET_8 CLK 0
V_L4 LABEL_NET_4 CLK 0
V_L7 LABEL_NET_7 CLK 0
V_L10 LABEL_NET_10 CLK 0

* Data Inputs (Return-to-Zero signaling)
V_L0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0
V_L1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0
* Toggle C (LABEL_NET_2) to evaluate N2 during cycle 1
V_L2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PWL(0 0 0.8n 0 0.9n 1.8 2.8n 1.8 2.9n 0)
V_L3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0
* Toggle E (LABEL_NET_5) to evaluate N4 during cycle 2
V_L5 LABEL_NET_5 0 PWL(0 0 4.8n 0 4.9n 1.8 6.8n 1.8 6.9n 0)
V_L6 LABEL_NET_6 0 0
V_L9 LABEL_NET_9 0 0

* Load Capacitors
C_N2 N2 0 10f
C_N4 N4 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 8n

* Measure N2 delays (Cycle 1)
meas tran t_eval_n2 trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_pre_n2 trig v(CLK) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 rise=1

* Measure N4 delays (Cycle 2)
meas tran t_eval_n4 trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(N4) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_pre_n4 trig v(CLK) val=0.9 fall=2 targ v(N4) val=0.9 rise=1

* Measure Average Power
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=8n
let avg_power = -avg_current * 1.8
print avg_power

quit
.endc
